name: Stefano
source: Younger brother to Roberto, Stefano is playful and good-natured with a strong sense of adventure. He holds an admiration for the mafia and is determined to follow in Roberto’s footsteps. Despite having dangerous aspirations, he is just a teenager who thinks he knows more about the world than he actually does.
